$comment: Brava (composite roof tiles, synthetic slate, cedar shake and barrel tile) is behind bot protection, so plain HTTP, headless Chrome and AvalAI's page fetch all fail with BOT_PROTECTION. The site uses the default engine (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance) with ai_fetch web_search; the shop is never contacted and the values are unverified (AI_UNVERIFIED). Engines tried on 2026-11-19: http and browser: BOT_PROTECTION; ai_fetch http and browser: BOT_PROTECTION; web_search: success (12 specs, 7 features, 563+430 tokens). Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key.
